headline: ams OSRAM seeks a leader for distributed AMS/DMS verification methodology and model libraries
fact: ams OSRAM posted a Senior Principal Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer role to lead a distributed verification team and own an AMS/DMS methodology roadmap. The mandate covers reusable EEnet/UDN model libraries, DMS-to-Spectre correlation, SystemVerilog/UVM-MS environments, assertions, coverage, regression, sign-off criteria, and Python automation. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate, not proof that every listed method was already deployed across the organization.

sources.title: Senior Principal Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer (d/m/f)
sources.summary: The official ams OSRAM posting identifies job 22937, its March 20, 2026 posting date, distributed-team leadership, and the AMS/DMS modeling, verification, correlation, coverage, regression, sign-off, and automation mandate; the original now reports that the position is no longer available.
